newsitem.title: USA: First Financial (Indiana) sets rights plan.
newsitem.headline: First Financial (Indiana) sets rights plan.

text.p: First Financial Corp (Indiana) said Monday its board approved adoption of a shareholder rights plan designed to discourage hostile takeover attempts.
The company said it is not aware of any current attempt to take control on a hostile basis.

The plan will distribute one right to buy more shares to current First Financial stockholders of record January 20 if an investor accumulates 12 percent or more of the company's stock, First Financial said. The rights will expire January 6, 2007 unless earlier redeemed or exchanged, the company said.
First Financial is a bank holding company.
